It sells domestically on a B-to-B and B-to-C basis under brands such as SLR 525, Platform, PCT-410, All Rounder, Afford, Aurthor, Liger, Raavan, Element, Runway and Fighter, and internationally on a B-to-B basis to customers in 37 countries.

currentContext.expansion: The company is expanding its international footprint into the Latin American market, having acquired GSP Agroquimica Do Brasil LTDA in Brazil in 2023, and is in the process of incorporating a subsidiary in Uruguay (subject to approvals). It operates five manufacturing facilities across Gujarat and Jammu & Kashmir with aggregate installed capacity of 15,120 MTPA Technicals, 43,672 MTPA Formulations and 5,400 MTPA Intermediates.

one-line thesis: GSP Crop Science is successfully pivoting from generic technicals to high-margin patented combinations (now 20% of revenue, targeting 40-50%), driving a 32% YoY EBITDA growth in 9MFY26 despite raw material inflation. The company's ability to fully pass through 10-15% cost increases in B2B channels and its focus on irrigation-independent crops (paddy) mitigates near-term macro risks like El Nino and Middle East conflicts.
financial scorecard: Revenue: INR 1,114 Cr (9MFY26); EBITDA: INR 153 Cr (+32% YoY), Margin ~13.7%; PAT: INR 75 Cr (reported, includes INR 4.5 Cr exceptional provision for labor wage code), Normalized PAT ~INR 79.5 Cr; Order Book: Not disclosed (seasonal B2C/B2B model); Net Debt: Not disclosed.
guidance: Revenue: Targeting 5-7% higher growth than historical CAGR over next 3 years; Margin: Patented products carry 20-25% premium over generics (55-60% gross margin vs 35-40%); Order Inflow: Strong acceptance of new insecticide/fungicide mix in paddy; Capex: No major greenfield capex, focusing on debottlenecking existing facilities.
order book & pipeline: N/A - Business operates on seasonal sales cycles with 45 days of imported inventory coverage.
segment / subsidiary detail: Domestic B2B (40%): High price elasticity, immediate cost pass-through. Domestic B2C (40%): 5,000 distributors, 24 C&F locations, slight lag in price realization. Exports (20%): 37 countries, B2B model, prices passed through globally.
growth verticals / optionality: Patented portfolio expansion (12 commercialized, 1-2 launches/year, targeting 40-50% revenue contribution in 3 years); Brazil subsidiary for exporting patented formulations; Nutrition products benefiting from fertilizer shortages.
margins & cost dynamics: Gross margin differential: Patented (55-60%) vs Generics (35-40%). Cost inflation (crude, logistics doubled from China) fully passed through in B2B (10-15% price hike); B2C seeing phased acceptance from April 1.
capex / expansion: Utilization: Technical plants 70-75% (peak 90%), Formulations 30-40% (seasonal). Peak capacity revenue potential: INR 1,900-2,000 Cr. Strategy focuses on debottlenecking rather than new capacity for next 3 years.
capital allocation: R&D investment for 5-year product development cycle; Registration costs (5 years/product); Working capital for 45-day import inventory.
risks & watch-items: El Nino impact on non-irrigated crops (mitigated by paddy focus); Prolonged Middle East conflict disrupting shipping beyond 1 month; Raw material availability from China; Regulatory delays in product registration.
management quality / tone: Confident on pricing power and product differentiation; Pragmatic about supply chain lags; Strategic focus on long-term R&D pipeline over rapid launch volume.
non-obvious takeaways: Co-marketing strategy involves white-labeling patented products for major peers (Rallis, Sumitomo, Mankind Agri, Chambal Fertilizers) to scale reach without incremental marketing spend; Nutrition products seeing surge due to fertilizer scarcity acting as a hedge.
challenges → beneficiaries & losers:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rising crude and logistics costs from China/Middle East conflict | GSP Crop Science Ltd | beneficiary | High | Company successfully passed through 10-15% price hikes in B2B and is seeing acceptance in B2C, protecting margins while competitors with lower pricing power may suffer. |
| Fertilizer shortage and high gas prices forcing farmers to seek alternatives | GSP Crop Science Ltd | beneficiary | Med | Shift in farmer spend towards nutrition products (seaweed, amino acids) where GSP has 3-4 offerings benefits their non-fertilizer revenue mix. |
| El Nino forecast for Kharif season potentially reducing crop sowing | Generic Agrochemical Peers | loser | Med | Peers heavily exposed to rain-dependent crops without GSP's strong paddy focus (40% consumption) or irrigation-independent portfolio may face volume pressure. |

themes.title: Import-substitution / China+1 specialty chemicals
themes.need: After the worst agrochem/chemicals year in living memory, the cycle is turning on China+1 reshoring and global pigment/dye consolidation. SUDARSCHEM is now #2 global pigment player post-Heubach; SUMICHEM posted record FY26 margins; AETHER/ANURAS/DEEPAKNTR/CLEAN add CRAMS + backward-integration; war-driven RM/freight inflation is being passed through. Q1FY27 shows the reshoring build-out actually landing: HSCL grew consolidated revenue 28% to INR 1,432cr with PAT INR 228cr (+27%) at a 22% EBITDA margin while opening three new value ladders in a single quarter (carbon nanotube 200 MTPA by Q4FY27, super-speciality carbon black 6,000 MTPA by FY28, and India's first commercial anthraquinone/carbazole plant), all self-funded with no incremental debt; TATVA grew revenue 43% YoY and delivered its first commercial-plant-scale semiconductor batch, qualified by the customer and called 'the glaring achievement of the past decade' (though commercialisation is explicitly not before Q4 CY2028); FCL tripled total income to INR 386.72cr (+165%) with Texas capacity nearly doubled to 148,000 MTPA and already running 63% on a single shift, so its next revenue leg needs only USD 1-2mn of capex.
themes.driver: Volume rebound as destocking ends; price hikes sticking; new value-ladder commissioning (HSCL CNT/carbon black) and semiconductor-materials qualification (TATVA).

themes.title: Agrochemicals & crop-input cycle recovery
themes.need: Crop-protection is recovering off a brutal trough, and Q1FY27 shows domestic branded volume decoupling from generic exports. RALLIS grew revenue only 7% yet lifted EBITDA 23% to a ~18.0% margin (+230bps) as domestic B2C rose 19% on +15% volume while exports COLLAPSED 28% (volume -35%) on Chinese pricing, and its seeds EBITDA margin went 26% to 30% on a rice/maize/millet mix versus price-controlled cotton - though PAT +31% is flattered by an INR 35cr employee-provision reversal of which INR 24cr is genuinely one-time, so normalise before extrapolating. The monsoon is the live variable: as of 8-Jul seasonal rainfall was ~15% below normal with kharif acreage ~21% below last year. SUMICHEM delivered record FY26 profitability; INSECTICID/DHANUKA/SHARDACROP ride premiumization + technicals; COROMANDEL/GNFC/CHAMBLFERT/GODREJAGRO add fertilizers + integrated agri.
themes.driver: Monsoon catch-up and kharif acreage recovery from ~21% below last year; domestic B2C volume against continued Chinese export price pressure; new molecule launches and biologicals scale-up.

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: Research-driven agrochemical company specializing in the development and manufacturing of insecticides, herbicides, fungicides and plant growth regulators in India, with over 40 years of industry experience.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: GSP Crop Science develops, manufactures, supplies and distributes crop-protection Formulations (products of active ingredients plus additives) and Technicals (concentrated active ingredients) across insecticides, herbicides, fungicides and plant growth regulators. It sells domestically on a B-to-B and B-to-C basis under brands such as SLR 525, Platform, PCT-410, All Rounder, Afford, Aurthor, Liger, Raavan, Element, Runway and Fighter, and internationally on a B-to-B basis to customers in 37 countries.

group_structure.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
group_structure.body:
- Rajdhani Petrochemicals Private Limited — Material Subsidiary: Among top 10 Indian applicants for PCT filings (RO/IN) in Fiscal 2022 (ICRA)
- GSP Intermediates Private Limited — Subsidiary
- GSP Agroquimica Do Brasil LTDA — Subsidiary (Brazil): Acquired in 2023 to expand into Latin American market
- BPI Chemtex Private Limited — Group Company
- Indo GSP Chemicals Private Limited — Group Company

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Formulations:** Insecticides, Herbicides, Fungicides, Plant growth regulators, 395 registrations as of Sep 30, 2025 (70.56% of FY25 product revenue)
- **Technicals:** Concentrated active ingredients used in formulations, 129 registrations as of Sep 30, 2025 (29.44% of FY25 product revenue)

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- Domestic Business (India) - 88.82% of FY25 revenue from continuing operations
- International Business (37 countries incl. Uruguay, USA, Vietnam, Brazil, Singapore, Bangladesh, UAE, Taiwan, Australia, Sri Lanka) - 11.18% of FY25 revenue
- Gujarat (largest state, 31.71% of FY25 revenue), Maharashtra (15.03% FY25)

certifications.title: Certs (RHP)
certifications.body:
- ISO 9001-2015
- ISO 14001-2015
- ISO 45001-2018
- Responsible Care Certification

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Backward integration into Technicals and Intermediates feeding own Formulations manufacturing; sources some Technicals externally. Domestic B-to-C distribution via ~5,644 distributors (FY25); International Business B-to-B across 37 countries; acquired GSP Agroquimica Do Brasil (2023) for Latin American expansion.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Ability to procure desired quality and quantity of raw materials (dependence on external suppliers via purchase orders)
- Product mix shift toward higher-margin Formulations (gross margin improved from 27.12% FY23 to 39.57% FY25)
- EBITDA margin expansion (6.75% FY23 to 12.74% FY25 to 16.45% H1 FY26)
- Domestic B-to-C distributor network (5,644 distributors in FY25)

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Expand International Business, particularly into Latin America and Uruguay (incorporating a subsidiary in Uruguay, subject to approvals)
- Continue investing in R&D and patented product development
- Grow Formulations mix and B-to-C brand distribution network
- Deleverage via repayment of borrowings from IPO proceeds

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: The company is expanding its international footprint into the Latin American market, having acquired GSP Agroquimica Do Brasil LTDA in Brazil in 2023, and is in the process of incorporating a subsidiary in Uruguay (subject to approvals). It operates five manufacturing facilities across Gujarat and Jammu & Kashmir with aggregate installed capacity of 15,120 MTPA Technicals, 43,672 MTPA Formulations and 5,400 MTPA Intermediates.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Well-diversified product portfolio of insecticides, herbicides, fungicides and plant growth regulators (524 registrations across Formulations and Technicals as of Sep 30, 2025)
- Strong in-house R&D with 102 patents granted and 108 patent applications under process; among first indigenous manufacturers of several patented formulations and technicals
- Large and diverse domestic and international clientele across 37 countries; several customers associated for over 10 years
- Five manufacturing facilities with backward integration into Technicals and Intermediates
- Patented-product revenue of Rs 1,436.75 million (17.10% of product sales) in H1 FY26

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Regulatory dependence on CIBRC registrations and licenses — Products require pre-approval registrations from the Central Insecticides Board and Registration Committee; increasingly stringent agrochemical regulation; some approvals expired or due to expire
- Raw material procurement and supplier dependence — Depends on external suppliers on a purchase-order basis; no long-term supply contracts
- Geographic revenue concentration in Gujarat — Gujarat contributed 31.71% of FY25 revenue
- Net debt / leverage — Net debt Rs 2,631.90 million and net debt/equity 0.58x as of FY25
- Reliance on commissioned ICRA industry report — Industry data commissioned and paid for by the company
- Promoter concentration — Promoters hold 90.55% pre-Offer

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Expand International Business into the Latin American market and incorporate a subsidiary in Uruguay**
- **Repay or pre-repay all or a portion of certain outstanding borrowings from the fresh issue proceeds**
- **Continue R&D-driven development of patented formulations and technicals**
- **Grow the Formulations mix and B-to-C brand distribution**

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Expand International Business, particularly into Latin America and Uruguay (incorporating a subsidiary in Uruguay, subject to approvals)
- Continue investing in R&D and patented product development
- Grow Formulations mix and B-to-C brand distribution network
- Deleverage via repayment of borrowings from IPO proceeds
